text:
elena: Quick heads up — we have 6 docs PRs queued for the Tuesday merge window. Need reviewers for 2 migration guides and 1 SDK snippet. Can folks pick up?

Tom: I'm +1 to review migration guide for v2 -> v3, can do it today. Ping me the PRs.

Jia: I can handle SDK snippet and link fixes. ETA EOD.

Mike: I can take the other migration guide but CI preview is flakey today — saw failures on css/code fences. @ci-bot any details?

ci-bot: docs-preview | Build started for PRs: #1423, #1426, #1431. Live preview URL: https://preview.redwood.ai/prs/1423

ci-bot: docs-preview | Build failed for PR #1426 — error: missing frontmatter 'sidebar_position' in /docs/migrate/v3.md

elena: ugh. @Mike can you patch that frontmatter? it's quick. Also prefer we avoid merging during the infra deploy on Tue 16:00 UTC, so target Wed morning merge window if possible.

Mike: will fix in a sec. small PR to add frontmatter and regenerate TOC.

Jia: added review comments to #1431 (SDK snippet): needs types for the example and a short note about auth. 

Tom: reviewed #1423 (migration guide) — left 2 small nits, otherwise LGTM. I'll re-approve after nits.

Mike: pushed fix for frontmatter and retriggered preview.

ci-bot: docs-preview | Build succeeded for PR #1426. Preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/prs/1426 :tada:

elena: sweet. Next: can we formalize reviewer ownership? currently gaps on migrations during release sprints. Proposal: rotation where one eng and one docs reviewer tag per PR. Thoughts?

Tom: love that. Maybe a weekly on-call for docs reviews, 2-3 people.

Jia: happy to be on rotation. Also can we add a CODEOWNERS entry for /docs/migrate/* ? helps auto-assign.

elena: yes — i'll open a tiny PR to add CODEOWNERS for migrate and sdk examples. Will also add a note in the docs CONTRIBUTING.md to request both tags.

Mike: ok queued. thanks all — i'll follow up if anything blocks the Wed window.

elena: thanks everyone :heart:
